ui_bugs.component: Mobile bottom-nav vs Sonner welcome toast
ui_bugs.issue: Immediately after login on mobile (390x844) the Sonner 'Welcome back, <name>' toast is anchored to bottom-right (position='bottom-right' in the top-level Toaster) and its element stacking sits ABOVE the fixed bottom-nav — during the toast's lifetime, taps on nlv2-tab-listen / nlv2-tab-shop / nlv2-tab-play / nlv2-tab-pay hit the toast's <li data-sonner-toast> instead of the Link and do NOT navigate (verified via document.elementFromPoint at each tab's center). Once the toast auto-dismisses, taps work normally.

action_items: Fix mobile bottom-nav overlap: either move the Sonner Toaster to position='top-right' on mobile widths (<lg), OR raise the BottomNavV2 stacking above the toaster (Sonner's default z ~= 9999999), OR add bottom offset to sonner via style/offset prop on the top-level <Toaster /> in App.js so it clears the 64px bottom nav + player dock area. Currently users can appear to be 'stuck' on Home for the ~4-5s the welcome toast is up.

Optional: also apply pointer-events:none on the toaster wrapper (it already has pointer-events:auto on individual toasts) — but the tap target inside the toast is what actually eats the click; safest fix is repositioning.

rca of the issue: Mobile tab-tap failure post-login RCA: Sonner Toaster (top-level in App.js) is rendered with `position='bottom-right'`. Its portal container is stacked at Sonner's own z-index (defaults to a very high value like 9999999), which sits above BottomNavV2's z-40. On a 390px viewport, the toast's <li data-sonner-toast> element visually covers the region occupied by nlv2-tab-listen, nlv2-tab-shop, nlv2-tab-play (and partly nlv2-tab-pay), so pointer events land on the toast li. Reproduction: 1) 390x844 viewport, 2) login as any user, 3) within 5s tap Listen/Shop/Play — URL stays at '/'; wait 5-6s for the toast to auto-dismiss then retry — navigation works. Mitigation: move the Toaster to `position='top-right'` on mobile OR pass `offset` so it sits above the 64px bottom nav + player dock.
